lines.zh: 步伐要稳，仪式不容差错。
lines.en: Steady steps; the rite allows no error.
My robe sweeps the mansion's stone floor.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，地毯会记住。
lines.en: Where I walk, the carpet remembers.
One step, one strike, one verse.
Make way, I must draw the circle.
The wooden floor gives way for me.
My shadow arrives before I do.
There should be a door at the corridor's end.
I chant in time with my own steps.
Slower, majesty takes time.
These shoes were not made for long walks.
The room ahead is still empty.
The mansion is far too quiet.

lines.zh: 我指尖还留着咒文的余温。
lines.en: My fingertips still hold the warmth of the chant.

lines.zh: 那些尖牙，从地里长出来。
lines.en: Those fangs, growing out of the earth.
The totem burns inside my sleeve.
I count the dust on the rafters.
No one comes to hear my chanting anymore.
I should summon a few more vexes.
The pattern of this tile is crooked.
The spell turns on my tongue.

lines.zh: 我从不坐下，坐下就老了。
lines.en: I never sit; sitting makes one old.
You entered a door you should not have.
Let me have a look at your bones.

lines.zh: 你身上没有图腾的味道。
lines.en: You carry no totem's scent.
Another visitor come to die.
Your shadow is trembling.
I know that look in your eyes.
Do not touch that wall, it is mine.

lines.zh: 你来晚了，仪式已经开始。
lines.en: You are late; the rite has begun.
Take off that helmet, let me see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你的脸刻在我的图腾上了。
lines.en: Your face is carved into my totem now.
You dared to touch my robe.
My chant was broken.
This body is too fragile.
It hurts, but the rite continues.

lines.zh: 我会让你付出十倍的代价。
lines.en: I will make you pay tenfold.
You interrupted my breathing.
Blood has soiled the pages.
I shall write this blade into my chant.

lines.zh: 我的恼鬼会替我讨回来。
lines.en: My vexes will collect the debt.
Do not think this means victory.
Emeralds? I stopped lacking those long ago.
Put it away, mortal bribe.

lines.zh: 你举着的不是绿宝石，骗子。
lines.en: That's no emerald in your hand, liar.
You would trade bread for a life?

lines.zh: 我的胃口是咒文养大的。
lines.en: My appetite was raised on scripture.
Take it away, the smell distracts me.
I want only your bones and your name.
Stop waving it, I am not looking.

lines.zh: 报酬？报酬是你留下的东西。
lines.en: Payment? Payment is what you leave behind.

lines.zh: 你若真想献上什么，跪下。
lines.en: If you truly wish to offer something, kneel.
Step back, you have disturbed the circle.
Do not touch the hem of my robe.
Your iron plate jabs into me.
Rude, like all villagers.
My bones cannot take such knocks.
Make way, I do not walk shoulder to shoulder.
You dirtied my shoe.
That was not an attack, it was an insult.
I will remember this shove.
Do not crowd, I reached the door first.

lines.zh: 我不需要同伴，只需要信徒。
lines.en: I need no companion, only followers.
My consort is this spellbook.

lines.zh: 灾厄之道不容儿女情长。
lines.en: The illager path allows no such tenderness.
Go away, do not speak of it.

lines.zh: 我的血只用来喂养咒文。
lines.en: My blood feeds only scripture.
I wed only power.
You are wasting my time.
Ask a villager about such things.
My room holds only books and ash.
Do not look at me that way.
This book is mine now.
I tuck the totem into my inner pocket.
Ritual materials, dropped on the floor.
An emerald, barely useful.
Do not mind what I pick up.
This bone can be ground to powder.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，它就属于仪式。
lines.en: I lift it, and it belongs to the rite.
A candle? I prefer torches.
This page is worth one more verse.

lines.zh: 我的袍子装得下很多东西。
lines.en: My robe holds many things.
You are standing in the center of the circle.
You, then. The offering.
I can see your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，先记住我的名字。
lines.en: Do not rush off; first remember my name.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲挡不住地下的牙。
lines.en: Your armor cannot stop fangs from below.

lines.zh: 目标已选定，咒文已备好。
lines.en: Target chosen, verses prepared.
You brought a weapon, good.

lines.zh: 我等你走进这个房间很久了。
lines.en: I have waited long for you to enter this room.
We begin beneath your feet.
You smell of iron.

lines.zh: 别让影子落在我的圈里。
lines.en: Do not let your shadow fall in my circle.
All I want is your undeath.
Look up, the vexes are above.
You are already written into the chant.

lines.zh: 你堵在门口，那就先从你起。
lines.en: You block the door. Then you go first.
Something moves beneath the tiles.
Back away, the fangs are coming.
Listen, the ground is chanting.
I am raising my hand.

lines.zh: 你站的位置很好，正对牙口。
lines.en: You stand well, right in the fangs' path.
Do not hide behind the pillar.
My spell needs three breaths.
Are you counting my fingers.
The fangs will form a ring.
Your steps have lost their rhythm.
The vexes are passing through the walls.
I have not finished; do not interrupt.
There are fangs behind you too.

lines.zh: 空地不多了，选个位置吧。
lines.en: Little ground remains; choose where to stand.

lines.zh: 我退到圈心，牙才排得齐。
lines.en: I step to the circle's center so the teeth line up.

lines.zh: 你踩过的那块砖，我记下了。
lines.en: That tile you crossed. Noted.

lines.zh: 我把手印按在空气里，圈就闭合。
lines.en: I press a seal into the air. The ring closes.

lines.zh: 恼鬼绕着你飞，你数不清几只。
lines.en: Vexes circle you. You lose count.
Rise from the earth, my fangs.
Fangs bite up from the earth.
This row is for you.
Through the soles of your boots.
Jump as high as you like, it won't help.
Second ring, close in.
Blood seeps into the cracks, perfect.
My fangs do not bite twice.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头的响声了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear the bones crack.
Stand still, let the fangs find you.
I practiced this strike for thirty years.
You retreated too slowly.
The fangs shake hands for me.

lines.zh: 别谢我，这是仪式的一部分。
lines.en: Do not thank me, it is part of the rite.

lines.zh: 一排牙从你脚前拔地而起。
lines.en: A row of teeth rises before your feet.

lines.zh: 牙咬住的不是你，是你的脚后跟。
lines.en: The teeth take not you, but your heel.
The mansion's door opens; I have come.
This room is mine now.
I step out from between the pages.
Ash settles on my shoulder; fitting.

lines.zh: 第一次呼吸，满是旧木头味。
lines.en: First breath, thick with old wood.
I will come only this once.
Anyone who comes must pass my fangs.
I arrive before the lamps go out.
The robe falls; the rite begins.
I have brought my vexes.
This mansion has waited for me to wake.

lines.zh: 名字不必问，我是唤魔者。
lines.en: Ask not my name; I am the Evoker.
Flame cannot burn away scripture.
My bones creaked like an old door.
Water in my throat; I cannot chant.
My robe has been torn open.
An arrow is lodged between my ribs.

lines.zh: 有人用我的法术对付我。
lines.en: Someone turns my own magic on me.
Hunger weakens the craft.
Even the sky's bolt would break my rite.
No chant reaches below the void.
